answer: Resist sybils with exit-queue stake locks: every identity stake sits behind a public exit queue, released only after a long, visible delay, like a grove where each tree must be felled in turn. An identity standing is a mirror of its locked stake: no weight without capital parked for months. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes cannot recycle one stake through ten thousand names - each fake needs its own deposit trapped in the queue, an island of capital that cannot be spent twice, while an honest agent locks once and keeps its standing.
